@Danilo Krummrich work on Tyr currently depends on two of your series being applied:

  • [PATCH 0/5] rust: sync: add WaitQueue infrastructure
    https://lore.kernel.org/rust-for-linux/20260726223613.1242940-1-dakr@kernel.org/

  • [PATCH 0/7] lifetime-parameterized DRM File private data
    https://lore.kernel.org/rust-for-linux/20260814230923.1292966-7-dakr@kernel.org

They need a bit of rebasing and conflict resolution. I've done this myself to review them with
@Alvin Sun ioctl series if that helps at all: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/dbrouwer/linux/-/tree/alvin-ioctls-v3

@Alice Ryhl you reviewed the WaitQueue series, but could you have a look at the lifetime-parameterized DRM File private data too as well.?

And thank you @Daniel Almeida for reviewing the DRM File series as well.
